name: Prince Mohammad bin Abdulaziz International Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longest, 17/35, is 4,335 m x 60 m (18/36 is 3,050 m x 45 m)

customs.v: customs and immigration around the clock

handling.v: general aviation handling by arrangement with Saudi Ground Services (SGS), HAVAS or Jet Aviation; two GA stands on the west side
handling.quote: ACFT handling by arrangement with Saudi Ground Services (SGS), HAVAS and JET Aviation for General Aviation services.

fuel.v: Jet A-1 available, fuelling around the clock

max_aircraft.v: handles aircraft up to ICAO code 4F (code 4E when runway 17/35 is out of use, by NOTAM)
max_aircraft.quote: can accommodate and handle types of aircraft in the category of up to Code 4F

notes: Read the airport operator's Aerodrome Manual TIBAH-AIROPS-MAN-01, Revision 6.2 (revision date 1 Aug 2022, effective 31 Jan 2023; the amendment record shows JAN 2022, so the dates are inconsistent), first 100,000 of about 500,000 characters only. This is an older document; re-check against the current Saudi eAIP before publishing. The Saudi eAIP (aimss.sans.com.sa) could not be opened: the known AMDT 02/26 OERK page URL was refused (permission not answered). The manual states no night restriction, PPR rule or GA slot rule; it says the airport serves all users unless closed by NOTAM. 'MED' appears only as an abbreviation for Medina, so the IATA code is left unrecorded.
